key_phrases: AI business has now surpassed an annual revenue run rate of $13 billion
Microsoft Cloud revenue was $40.9 billion and grew 21%
We would rather win the new than just protect the past
scale motion... challenges in what we call the scale motion
analysis.reasoning: The overall sentiment is highly positive, driven by explosive AI-related growth (Azure AI up 157%) and the successful transition of Copilot from POC to enterprise deployment. Management shows extreme confidence in their 'fleet' strategy and the ability to capture AI scaling laws. While there was a slight dip in non-AI Azure growth due to 'scale motion' execution challenges (as noted by the CFO), this was framed as a strategic rebalancing rather than a fundamental weakness. CapEx is aggressively high but justified by massive RPO ($298B) and capacity constraints. The only slight drag is the 'scale motion' issue in the non-AI segment and the impact of FX, but these are treated as manageable headwinds. The innovation momentum is at a maximum due to the integration of agentic workflows and first-party silicon.
